analysis_set.span: Treatment-effect analyses were based on the intention-to-treat principle, as described in the companion paper on vitamin D.

follow_up.span: During a median follow-up of 5.3 years, a major cardiovascular event occurred in 386 participants in the n-3 group and in 419 in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.92; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.80 to 1.06; P=0.24).

entry_age.span: be men aged 50 or older or women aged 55 or older;

entry_other.span: a general population selected only on age and not on vascular risk factors such as diabetes or dyslipidemia

notes: ITT is stated for treatment-effect analyses generally. Entry only partly matches the question: this was a usual-risk primary-prevention population without required elevated cardiovascular risk; this does not imply that all participants lacked risk factors.
